actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed

facts.text: The README describes the package as implementations of various RL algorithms for continuous control tasks simulated with MuJoCo
The README lists MuJoCo, python=3.7, gym>=0.13, mujoco-py>=2.0 and pytorch>=1.0 as the main dependencies
setup.py describes the package as 'RL algorithms for environments in MuJoCo'
mjrl_swimmer-v0 is registered with entry_point mjrl.envs:SwimmerEnv and max_episode_steps 500
SwimmerEnv constructs MujocoEnv with the model name 'swimmer.xml' and frame_skip 5
mujoco_env resolves a relative model path under its own assets directory and loads it with load_model_from_path, wrapped in MjSim
The action space is a Box whose low and high are the columns of model.actuator_ctrlrange
The environment step time is model.opt.timestep times frame_skip
do_simulation writes ctrl for every actuator and calls sim.step frame_skip times
SwimmerEnv.step returns reward -10.0 times the change of qpos[0] and done False
SwimmerEnv.get_obs concatenates qpos[2:] and the whole qvel
SwimmerEnv.reset_model draws qpos[2] uniformly from -pi to pi and keeps the other initial values
The model root element is '<mujoco model="swimmer">' and its compiler sets inertiafromgeom true and angle radian
The global default class declares limited=true range -1.5 1.5 for joints and ctrllimited=true ctrlrange -1 1 for motors
The option element sets timestep 0.005 s, viscosity 0.000894 and density 1000
The torso body carries two slide joints and one hinge joint, and the tail is a chain of the hinge joints j1, j2, j3 and j4
The actuator section declares four motor actuators, on joints j1 to j4 with gear 20, and states no ctrlrange on any of them

determinism.notes: The stand-in integrates each motor's gear-scaled effort against a placeholder unit inertia from the zero reset state; it has no seed input and is not MuJoCo physics.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the pinned MJCF for the joint layout, the actuator count, the inherited control ranges and the option time step, then integrates each actuated one-DOF joint's gear-scaled effort against a placeholder unit inertia; it computes no body inertia, constraint, contact, water or actuator dynamics, so no trajectory is a MuJoCo result
the model's four motor actuators (gear 20) supply effort, not position targets; the stand-in uses that gear but omits fluid drag, coupling and joint-limit forces, so its motion differs from MuJoCo
the stand-in loads no mesh, texture, camera or sensor and resolves no ground contact, even though the model declares a plane floor and a capsule body chain
the stand-in has no mj_getState/mj_setState/mj_stateSize, so the bridge uses its basic checkpoint profile: time, qpos, qvel and ctrl are restored, not MuJoCo's full integration state
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so the stand-in was not compared with the real engine and the sim backend that imports mujoco was not run

the upstream swimmer task layer is NOT COVERED: the reward, the 12-value observation, the random qpos[2] reset and the 500-step time limit are not served; the driver serves the model step and reset only
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the integration state is kept and stays readable
